speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this fatigue and itching, and have you noticed any darkening of your urine or pale stools?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of autoimmune conditions other than ulcerative colitis, and have you noticed any yellowing of your skin or eyes? Also, have you experienced any recent weight loss or abdominal pain?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. I also have Scleral icterus, Multiple scratch marks on trunk and extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Liver Function Tests, Antimitochondrial Antibodies, IgG levels.
Given your history of ulcerative colitis, scleral icterus, and severe pruritus, I suspect primary sclerosing cholangitis or autoimmune hepatitis, so I need these specific markers to differentiate.
